messages:
Elaine: FYI — we just got a support ticket: token cost dashboard showing $0 and NaN for a handful of orgs (EU region). Reported since ~2026-03-15 02:00 UTC.

Jorge: Seen one in the queue as well. Customer provided org_id: org_9f2b. Screenshot shows $0 total and NaN for 'per-model' tiles.

SupportBot: Ticket #CS-4123 created and linked to this thread. Priority set to high by customer due to billing concerns.

SRE-Oncall: Quick triage — is this UI-only or also in the raw metering/ledger? Can someone paste the raw query / API response?

Jorge: Repro steps from customer: 1) Console -> Billing -> Token cost 2) select Org: org_9f2b 3) Date range: 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-14 4) See $0 / NaN on top-line and tiles. They say tokens were used (they have API logs).

Elaine: I pulled a sample from the ledger service for that org/time window. API shows token_count records exist. Example row: { "org_id": "org_9f2b", "date": "2026-03-12", "tokens": 12450, "unit_cost": 0.0006 }

DataEng-Alex: Thanks. Can you run this query against billing_reporting today index?

DataEng-Alex: ```sql
SELECT b.org_id, SUM(b.tokens * b.unit_cost) as calc_cost, r.reported_cost
FROM billing_ledger b
LEFT JOIN reporting_costs r ON b.org_id = r.org_id AND b.date = r.date
WHERE b.org_id = 'org_9f2b' AND b.date BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-14'
GROUP BY b.org_id, r.reported_cost;
```

Jorge: Ran it — calc_cost = 7.47, reported_cost = NULL. So left join left the reported_cost null, and front-end rendering treats NULL as NaN/$0 in some aggregation paths.

SRE-Oncall: That suggests the nightly aggregation job that populates reporting_costs failed or produced nulls for these orgs. Any job errors around 2026-03-15 02:00 UTC?

Ops-Bot: job-run: nightly_reporting_agg v2026.03.15 failed on task `join-report` at 2026-03-15T02:07:11Z. Error: "IndexOutOfRangeException in partitioner". CI link: https://ci.internal/jobs/nightly_reporting_agg/2026-03-15

DataEng-Alex: Bingo. The job failed mid-window and left partial rows with reported_cost=NULL. Our dashboard code expects reported_cost to be present; when it's NULL we coerce to NaN. We should fix two things: (1) ensure the aggregation is atomic/transactional or writes zero for missing; (2) backfill affected dates.

Billing-Leads: Which orgs are impacted? Need list to notify customers. Also need to confirm whether any billing invoices were already generated.

DataEng-Alex: Quick list I pulled from the partial table scan (sample): org_9f2b, org_2c8a, org_7e11, org_eu44. I will run a complete scan and post CSV in ~20m.

Elaine: Customer-facing note: please craft a short message — "We are investigating a dashboard reporting issue showing incorrect token cost figures for a subset of orgs. No invoices were affected; we will confirm once backfill completes." Do we know about invoices?

Billing-Leads: Invoices run on 03-01 and 03-15. The affected dates are within usage window but invoices should be unchanged because billing uses ledger as source, not reporting_costs. Confirmed: ledger unaffected. Good to reassure customers.

DataEng-Alex: Proposed immediate remediation steps:
- fix aggregation to COALESCE(reported_cost, 0) on write and guard against partial commits
- re-run nightly_reporting_agg for 2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-16 with a deterministic backfill
- add a dashboard alert for `reported_cost IS NULL` on reporting_costs

SRE-Oncall: Sounds good. Any risk to production UI or DB locks during backfill?

DataEng-Alex: Backfill will write to a staging table then swap. No downtime expected. Will throttle. I will trigger via Airflow. Command to trigger (ops): `airflow dags trigger nightly_reporting_agg --conf '{"start_date":"2026-03-10","end_date":"2026-03-16"}'`

Ops-Bot: Airflow trigger accepted: run id `manual__2026-03-16T12:04:00`

Jorge: For immediate mitigation on the UI, can we coerce NULL -> 0 in the frontend rendering while backfill runs? Quick patch would stop NaN display.

DataEng-Alex: We can do that. Patch: change aggregator to `value = reported_cost ?? 0` in backend reporting API, and render 2 decimals. Will open PR.

DataEng-Alex: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/reporting/pulls/482 — includes COALESCE on write + API null guard. CI green pending staging deploy.

SRE-Oncall: Noted. Please add a feature flag for the UI guard so we can toggle if anything weird happens.

DataEng-Alex: Added feature flag `reporting.null_guard_v1`. Using it for the API patch.

Ops-Bot: Staging deploy for reporting API succeeded: tag reporting@2026.03.16-1. Monitoring endpoint: /health/reporting — OK.

DataEng-Alex: Backfill started at 2026-03-16T12:15Z. ETA ~45m. Writing to `reporting_costs_staging` then atomic swap.

Billing-Leads: Please share final org list and timeline to operations so CS can notify impacted customers after backfill finishes.

DataEng-Alex: Full impacted org list posted to the ticket CS-4123 and uploaded CSV to the ticket. Backfill progress: 25% -> 60% -> 100%.

Ops-Bot: Backfill finished successfully. Swap executed at 2026-03-16T12:58Z. Rows updated: 12,342.

Jorge: I re-ran the earlier verification query for org_9f2b: reported_cost now = 7.47, UI shows $7.47.

Elaine: Confirmed with customer — dashboard now shows correct numbers. Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick turnaround." :tada:

DataEng-Alex: Postmortem items:
- change aggregator to write 0 instead of NULL for missing reported_cost (done)
- harden partitioner to avoid IndexOutOfRange (ticket #ENG-9082)
- add alert for `reported_cost IS NULL` and for `nightly_reporting_agg` task failures (done)
- add e2e test that simulates partial job failure

SRE-Oncall: Assign ENG-9082 to infra. Also please add a runbook snippet: when nightly_reporting_agg fails, mark partial outputs as invalid and schedule backfill automatically.

Billing-Leads: CS message approved. We'll send a short heads-up to the 4 affected customers and note invoices unaffected.

Elaine: Closing the thread — everything patched and backfilled. I'll create a short summary and link the postmortem doc in #all-hands once ENG-9082 is scheduled. Thanks all for the quick help.

SupportBot: Ticket #CS-4123 updated: status -> resolved.
